translations.web: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
translations.bsb: By the blessing of the upright a city is built up, but by the mouth of the wicked it is torn down.
translations.kjv: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
translations.asv: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted; But it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
